# Noto Sans SemiBold (SIL Open Font License 1.1, OFL.txt)

`NotoSans-SemiBold.ttf`, hinted TTF from notofonts/notofonts.github.io,
version 2.013. Used by /add-subtitles-to-video: libass in the ffmpeg core
draws burned-in captions with it (written into ffmpeg's filesystem next to
the SRT, `fontsdir=.`). FreeType there reads TTF, not the site's WOFF2.
Latin, Greek and Cyrillic only; the page says so.
